text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} makes his way to a forest on the outskirts of Landosol
after hearing reports of monster activity being on the rise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物たちの動きが活発化しているとの報告を受け、
{0}はランドソルの外れの森を訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
There, a monster's roar resounds throughout the forest,
prompting him to immediately rush to the source as fast as he can...
text_block_list.orig_text:
足を踏み入れるとすぐに、魔物の咆哮が聞こえてきた。
{0}は急いで現場へと向かった……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The monster continues to roar,
leading {0} to grab his sword. But then—
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物が咆哮を上げている。
{0}が剣を握り締めると──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.text: ...Why are you running?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……何で逃げるの。

text_block_list.text:
......
Who are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
あなた、
誰……？

text_block_list.text: ...I don't know you.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……知らない人。

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
...Why did you come here, mister?
I hate people that I don't know.
choice_data_list: I came to deal with some monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おにいさん、
何しに来たの。
ルナ、
知らない人……
嫌い。

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
A monster?
...I hate monsters too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物？
……ルナ、
魔物嫌い。

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
They won't come on my adventure...
And they always run away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おともだちになってくれないし……
逃げるから。

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: I want people to come on my adventure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナ、
おともだちが欲しいの。

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so alone.
But they always run away.
Why do they do that...?
choice_data_list: First and foremost, let's get out of this forest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって……
さみしいから。
でも、
みんな逃げるの。
どうして……？

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
...That's fine with me.
In exchange though...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……別にいいよ。
でも、
その代わり……

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: Will you come on my adventure?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ルナのおともだちになってくれる？

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
Yay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんと！？
やったぁ！

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: Okay then...
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ……

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: Don't run away, now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対、
逃げないでね！

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
...!
Why?!
Why won't you die for me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
何で！？
何で、
死んでくれないの！

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text:
You're a liar...!
Just like those monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいさんも嘘つきだ……！
魔物と一緒だ！

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, whatever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ、
もういい！

text_block_list.name: Luna
text_block_list.text: I hate you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいさんなんか、
嫌い！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Luna dashes off into the nearby bushes following her outburst.
text_block_list.orig_text: ルナは茂みの中に飛び込んでしまった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} gives up on trying to chase her,
instead opting to deal with the rest of the monsters in the forest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はルナを追いかけることを諦めて、
森の魔物を倒すことにした。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Once done, he makes his way out of the forest,
only to encounter an old woman nearby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物の討伐を終え、森を出る{0}。
すると、森の出口に一人の老婆が立っていた。

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
...Young fellow,
you entered that forest, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そこのお方。
あの森に入ったんだね。

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Did you see a girl in there perhaps?
A young one?
text_block_list.orig_text:
女の子を見なかったかい？
まだ、幼い……

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, as I thought...
She must have done something terrible to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
そうかい……
あの子にひどいことをされただろう。

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
But please forgive her.
She's still oblivious to the truth.
Completely and utterly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……許してやっとくれ。
あの子はまだ、
何も知らないんだ。
何もね……

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
No one's to blame but me.
My actions in this forest were...
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いのは……あたしなのさ。
あたしが
この森で起こしたことが……

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
...Ah,pardon me.
I'm sure this old fossil's story will only bore you to tears.
Forget I said anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あぁ、
いけないねぇ。
年寄りの昔話なんて、
聞きたくないだろう。
悪いねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Either way, you should stay away from here.
It's dangerous...
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
ここには近づかない方がいいよ。
危ないからね……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} watched the old woman walk away,
then returned to Landosol himself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
去っていく老婆の背中を見送ると、
{0}はランドソルへと戻るのだった。
